argv: for tool in node npm python3 psql postgres initdb pg_ctl createdb; do if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1; then "$tool" --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed "s#^#$tool=#"; else echo "$tool=MISSING"; fi; done; if test -d frontend/node_modules; then echo frontend_node_modules=PRESENT; else echo frontend_node_modules=MISSING; fi
